# THE ETERNITY (64x64): Ryan dissolved into a two-arm purple-black spiral around a white core; the drumsticks
# stay crossed, white and perfectly still at the center. Bands run void (outer) -> bright (inner), so a runtime
# palette cycle 0->1->2->3->4->5 shifted inward every few frames reads as the swirl falling into itself.
name: ryan_eternity
frame: 64x64
palette:
  . = transparent
  0 = #0a0612     # void

  3 = #6a2a8a     # bruise
  4 = #a050c0     # glow
  5 = #e0b0ff     # bright
  w = #f8f8f8     # core / drumsticks
anim: loop  frames: 0 1 2 3 4 5  fps: 8
